# hax11ty

> project documentation

This site was built with HAX11ty from markdown and HTML files, and is compatible with HAXcms.
The canonical structure is expressed in `site.json` using JSON Outline Schema (`id`, `parent`, `order`, `slug`, `location`, and `metadata`).
`site.json`, feeds, the search index and this `llms.txt` are generated by the build and should not be edited by hand.

## Core resources

- [site.json](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/site.json): Canonical site manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema format.
- [llms.txt](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/llms.txt): LLM-oriented guide to this site and its machine-readable resources.

## Optional

- [Search index](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/lunrSearchIndex.json): Lunr corpus for quick full-text retrieval.
- [RSS feed](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/rss.xml): Site updates in RSS format.
- [Atom feed](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/atom.xml): Site updates in Atom format.
- [Sitemap](https://haxtheweb.github.io/hax11ty/sitemap.xml): URL-level discovery map for the published site.
